title: SvgPolyline
responsibility: Renders the native polyline element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgPolyline.attributes
inputs.description: Native polyline attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgPolyline.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native polyline element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgPolyline
outputs.description: The actual native polyline element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
